summary_en: DAI-DAN authorized the acquisition of up to 6.0 million shares (4.63% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥10.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 to February 19, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on February 26, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, DAI-DAN's Board of Directors resolved to acquire up to 6.0 million shares of its own common stock, representing 4.63% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum expenditure of ¥10.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 to February 19, 2027. All shares acquired under this authorization will be cancelled on February 26, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback and subsequent cancellation are intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 8,347,882 treasury shares, with 129,543,524 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
